official_name: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Framework
objective: Protect safety, health, welfare and social security of construction workers.
description: Framework based on: BOCW (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act 1996 and BOCW Welfare Cess Act 1996 (now subsumed under OSH Code 2020 and Code on Social Security 2020). State BOCW Welfare Boards register eligible workers and provide welfare from welfare fund. Registration: age 18-60; 90+ days construction work in last 12 months. Benefits vary by state: life insurance, disability, health, maternity, education, pension, housing. BOCW MIS Portal: bocw.labour.gov.in.
implementing_agency: State/UT Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Boards
